integrity: The full labeled profile domain is exhausted by a compiled verifier. scientific_limitations: The exact finite classification covers four candidates and odd electorates through five voters under complete strict ballots, margin strength, and the set-valued parallel-universe interpretation of Ranked Pairs. The 1987 Ranked Pairs paper is bibliographically earlier, but the inspected publisher record supplies only a publication month; the stored date is the earliest day-resolved public date verified among the inspected criterion-specific sources.
title: Sharp five-voter divergence boundary for Schulze and parallel-universe Ranked Pairs
